title: B.P.R.D. Collectible Ring — Hellboy II: The Golden Army
description:
B.P.R.D. Collectible Ring — Hellboy II: The Golden Army

A wearable replica of the Bureau for Paranormal Research and Defense insignia, released as movie merchandise associated with Guillermo del Toro’s Hellboy II: The Golden Army (2008). A contemporary comic-shop new-release list dated April 7, 2010 explicitly records the “HELLBOY 2 BPRD RING SIZE 10” (RES), priced at US $25. This confirms the ring’s retail listing on that date, two years after the film premiered.

CATALOG DETAILS
Release listing: April 7, 2010 (documented for size 10)
Contemporary list price: US $25
Diamond catalog code: OCT091566
Manufacturer: Gentle Giant Studios (collector attribution; independently unconfirmed for this specific ring)
Material: Base-metal alloy with blue and black enamel (collector-reported)
Replica: Described as 1:1 prop reproduction (collector-reported)
Reported sizes: US 10, 11, 12 (only size 10 verified in the cited listing)
Edition size: Not documented

Source: https://graphicpolicy.com/2010/04/06/new-releases-472010/
